-  have no drop-in library replacement; they can use the javaagent or migrate to the Java API Client.

replies.body: Updated the note to state that query-body capture becomes unconditional in 3.0, with no replacement for the capture toggle. Sanitization remains separately configurable through `otel.instrumentation.opensearch.query-sanitization.enabled`. The Elasticsearch entry already documents its sanitization opt-out and is unchanged.

The declarative `host` detector is unchanged. Keeping the new opt-in capability under enhancements.
